offering_description.value: Owns, leases and manages open-air shopping centers in suburban US markets. Leases space to retail tenants such as grocers, off-price retailers, restaurants and service providers. Following the 2024 spin-off of Curbline Properties, it holds a smaller remaining portfolio of larger shopping centers.

primary_services.value: shopping center leasing; property management; property redevelopment and leasing

customer_segment.value: B2B: national and regional retail tenants, grocers, restaurants, service businesses

end_markets.value: retail real estate; grocery; off-price retail; restaurants; consumer services

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: base rent and tenant expense recoveries from shopping center tenants

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates shopping centers, leasing space to retail tenants

geography_served.value: US national: Shopping centers in suburban markets across multiple US states

specialization.value: niche specialist: ownership and leasing of open-air shopping centers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house leasing team and brokers lease space directly to retail tenants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: REIT tax rules, zoning, environmental and building regulations, and securities rules

notes: Portfolio and scale changed after the 2024 Curbline spin-off; unsure of any later changes through 2026.
